_source: Old 3DS chapter data, compiled 2026-10-08 from docs/research/native (NEXT.md C4-C8, n60-design.md, n60-progress.md, hwprof-progress.md, r60-research.md, per-agent progress docs), this project's own hardware-test logs, and git history. Every figure below is copied from one of those; 'fps' values derived from a frame time are 1000/ms and are marked 'derived'. Times are local (EDT).

cards.name: Shipped build (RDRAM 16)
cards.what: The released New 3DS build, unchanged, installed as a CIA
cards.hw: Dies in the boot preload: [fatal] operator new failed size=175844 heapFree=32424. Console answers memtype=0, heap grant 24 MiB (25,165,824 B)

cards.name: First boot (RDRAM 8)
cards.what: -DGDX_3DS_RDRAM_MB=8, audio_stream=1, tex_upload_kb=512; legacy interpreter (native all=0)
cards.hw: Boots and races. Wall p50 96.0 ms (p10 88.7, p90 111.3); GPU busy 3.6 ms; oth 37.3 ms. User: "it ran ! at like 9fps"

cards.name: C4 run 1: O3DS profile
cards.what: -DGDX_3DS_O3DS=ON (RDRAM 8 MiB + 16 MiB linear pin: 38.9 MB heap), owned interpreter all=1 interp=1
cards.hw: GP wall 88 ms (11.3 fps), TT/menu 43.7 ms; aud 25.8 ms = audio-lock wait, confirmed on hardware

cards.name: C4 run 2: narrow audio lock
cards.what: audio_ctx_narrow=1
cards.hw: aud 25.8 → 0.2 ms; race wall 67.8 ms (14.7 fps), light scenes 40 ms

cards.name: Wave 2: HOME + audio SIMD
cards.what: HOME bisect builds; audio_simd verify
cards.hw: HOME freeze root cause isolated (bottom backlight session); 7/7 HOME resumes with screen on; audio_simd verify 391/0/0, 0 mismatches on silicon

cards.name: Wave 3: frameskip + O3DS preset
cards.what: frameskip=auto, preset=o3ds, gpuxf=1, DrawProbe calibration CIA
cards.hw: Logic 57–60 ticks/s (game at full speed for the first time); drawn 19–28 fps in races. User: "playable but nausea inducing". DrawProbe: 10.9 µs CPU per draw, 14 Mtri/s

cards.name: REL1
cards.what: All C5 stage-1 levers + O3DS code generation (cold -Os, hot-first order)
cards.hw: Boot crash, deterministic. Four-title bisect: cold -Os crashes, stock and -O2+order boot

cards.name: REL2
cards.what: Stock codegen, frameskip=steady, HUD/machine/track retained paths
cards.hw: Boots. Race ~15 fps rendered (steady stuck at D=4), rw50 26–35 ms, "lots of awkward hitching": synchronous SD log flushes of 26–270 ms on main

cards.name: REL3
cards.what: Every exact lever on, async file log, overlap kick
cards.hw: "no hitches, steadier"; steady mostly D=3 (20 fps rendered), rw50 24–36 ms

cards.name: HWPROF B
cards.what: PMU counters (c5pmu) and the r60 probe
cards.hw: Render CPI 4.34, 43.6% of cycles in instruction-fetch stalls; probe CPI 1.06 at 16 KB of hot code, 4.10 at 24 KB, 5.62 at 32 KB

cards.name: REL4
cards.what: + pose replay (C6), compact HUD/sky emitter
cards.hw: 20 rendered + 20 replayed images/s, 1.3 ms per replay, but sky jitter, black tearing edges, giant fx triangles. 26.8 ms CPU per rendered frame. User: "we should go for a real 60!"

cards.name: n60-m1 (NRR milestone 1)
cards.what: Native race renderer: HUD, track, machines, sky; nrr_direct=2 verify run
cards.hw: Hard freeze at race start. Cause: verify mode's state save/restore rolled back libctru's live GX queue (the emulator's GSP completes synchronously and cannot show it)

cards.name: n60-card2
cards.what: All seven NRR categories (+ shadows, fx, dressing), GX-queue fix
cards.hw: RUN V: 199,472 draws verified, bad=0, float24 max 0.011 px. RUN C: TT "silk 60 fps"; GP W median 14.2 ms = 57.3 fps outside log-flush windows (51.9 fps all windows), harsh hitch every ~1/5 lap

cards.name: n60-card3
cards.what: Never-blocking log, frameskip=race0, save fix, swap gate, texture fixes, HUD memo, native tunnel joins and decorations
cards.hw: Race median 16.5 ms, 0 race hitches; save persisted across a power cycle. User: "omg it ran amazing!"

cards.name: interim legacy 3D
cards.what: card-3 build + [stereo] enabled=1 (NRR refused stereo, legacy path)
cards.hw: Black sky: the NRR sky consumed the section but could not draw under stereo

cards.name: n60-3d
cards.what: Stereo on the NRR: one frame body, resubmitted for the right eye with a per-eye uniform
cards.hw: No glitches; 3D race ~19.8 ms vs 16.5 ms 2D (frame-begin GPU wait 6.6 vs 3.3 ms) → 33 ms quantum, cost guard flapping, ~40 fps

cards.name: n60-3d2
cards.what: Right eye interleaved per submitted chunk
cards.hw: 2D 60 in GP and TT. 3D "40s and 50s": every race tripped the guard in the intro; steady 3D GP ≈ 48–57 fps

cards.name: n60-3d3
cards.what: End-mode swap pacing in 3D, intro HUD fix, 1 Hz menu refresh fix, launch variants
cards.hw: Mute City 3D ~60 in end mode (hold 1 on 250–255 of 256 frames); Silence and Sand Ocean heavier (work 16–18 ms)

cards.name: n60-3d4
cards.what: + track merge, per-draw diet, prewarm, HUD compile, FINISH mesh, lcd_vram=1
cards.hw: Crash at boot on all three variants, no log: LCD framebuffers in VRAM, which the CIA maps read-only for the CPU

cards.name: card 4 (VRAM fix)
cards.what: Same build, two levers off in the SD ini
cards.hw: 3D GP courses 12–16: race windows hold 1 on 245–256 of 256 frames at work ≈15.5 ms → ≈59–60 fps. VERIFY variant bad=0. Heavy windows only on the post-race results table
